power.jaymospowers.zfighter.desc: A martial artist who fights with his fists and his ki. No foe fells him twice, every defeat makes him stronger, and through hardship he breaks through to Super. He eats an enormous amount.
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.starter: Charge Ki (hold, weak): ki slowly gathers while you stand your ground. Passive: strong bare fists (weapons won't strike in your hand)
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ability_: Charge Ki (hold): the aura flares and ki pours in (1 per tick) while you slow to a crawl; hungry work
Ki Blast: a fast bolt of ki from the palm (8 ki, 5 damage, knocks back)
Ki Wave (hold, release): gather ki between cupped hands for up to 3 s, then a beam through everything in a 40-block line and a blast where it ends (25-60 ki, 8-24 damage)
Flash Step: gone in a blink, up to 10 blocks the way you look; aimed at a creature, behind it (15 ki)
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.mode: Flight: rise on your ki and fly like creative (2 ki a second in the air); %5$s again to come down
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ultimate: Super (needs 30 ki): a blast of gold throws back everything near; fists 60% harder, ki techniques 50%, 25% faster, flight faster. Burns 1.5 ki a second and a great deal of food; %6$s again to let it go
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_hungry: Your stomach roars. You need to eat.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_starving: Too hungry to gather any ki.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fists_only: A true fighter uses his fists.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_never_agai: You will never fall to %s again.
